title: Catholic Deliverance Power - Videos
description:
Prayers for Faith building, Self Healing & Personal Deliverance! Just be present before the Lord. He will come Find you n' Touch you.. For sure!

Power of the Lordship of Jesus Christ along with the Power of the Holy Sacraments, the Intercession of Blessed Mary the Virgin Mother of God, the authority of the Holy Apostolic Catholic Church, Holy Angels & Arch Angels, the Communion of Saints and Blessed Spirits gives us an impeccable/impenetrable ring of protection, healing and deliverance.... Do nothing, but be ready with an expectant heart to - Be Blessed, Healed,  Delivered - by the power of the Most Holy Blood of Jesus Christ, by His Cross and Glorious Resurrection. 

The most fearful enemy that God has set up against the devil is Mary, his holy Mother. Satan, being so proud, suffers infinitely more in being vanquished and punished by a lowly and humble servant of God, for her humility humiliates him more than the power of God. - St. Louis de Montfort. Long prayers, Keep it running..
